properties.disease overview: A common benign bone tumor (cartilage-capped bony outgrowth), typically arising from the metaphysis in adolescents/young people; often presents as a painless hard mass and is usually managed conservatively unless symptomatic.
properties.mechanism: Developmental/benign osteocartilaginous exostosis with a hyaline cartilage cap continuous with underlying cortex and medullary cavity; symptoms arise from mechanical irritation, compression, or rarely malignant transformation.
